newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Metro buys Filinvest stake in land project.
newsitem.headline: Metro buys Filinvest stake in land project.

text.p: Metro Pacific Corp said on Friday it had agreed to buy Filinvest Group's 16 percent stake in Bonifacio Land Corp.
Metro Pacific said price was 5.36 billion pesos.
Bonifacio Land Corp is made up of 17 private firms which hold 55 percent of Fort Bonifacio Development Corp, developer of a 214-hectare lot on the edge of Makati, Manila's financial district.
"We are delighted to move to a controlling position in Bonifacio Land through this transaction," said Metro Pacific in a joint statement with Filinvest.
Metro Pacific director Seumas Gallacher told Reuters the company's stake in Bonifacio Land now totals about 56 percent.
Filinvest said its decision to sell its stake was based on the board's decision to deploy resources in property projects where it has management control.
Proceeds from the sell-out will be used for Filinvest's property and non-property ventures, the company said.
Earlier, Filinvest Development Corp and its subsidiary Filinvest Land Inc had said they were open to selling their holdings in Bonifacio Land.
Metro Pacific, a diversified concern, is a unit of Hong Kong's First Pacific Co Ltd.
